comparisons.peer_topic: Composition and Concentration of Alternative Equity Securities
comparisons.peer_summary: Alternative equity securities included $12.6 billion in private equity positions and $0.8 billion in public equity positions (converted from private equity upon IPOs) as of December 2024. Real estate equity concentrations included 14% multifamily, 5% mixed use, 3% industrials, 2% office, and 3% other as of December 2024.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs disclose specific multifamily exposure concentrations or performance metrics within their real estate portfolios. JPMorgan reports that its total multifamily exposure is approximately 99% performing and is largely located in California. In contrast, Goldman Sachs discloses the composition of its alternative equity securities in real estate, noting that multifamily represented 14% of real estate equity securities as of December 2024, compared to 13% in 2023. While JPMorgan focuses on loan performance and geography, Goldman Sachs focuses on equity allocation percentages within private/public equity holdings.
